title: HARD COVER SERIES OF REFERENCE...
reason: Nine copies of a respected Ben Hall reference (Penzig, The Sandy Creek Bushranger), mis-described as a series; single copies ask about AU$50-75 so the lot is likely $100-250 to a bookseller (my estimate), more if any are signed numbered copies.
findings: The title says 'hard cover series of reference books' but the photos show at least nine identical copies of one single title: 'The Sandy Creek Bushranger: A Definitive History of Ben Hall, His Gang and Associates' by Edgar F. Penzig (cover text read). Hardcovers with a colour pictorial cover (saddle, revolvers, oval portrait) and green edges. Four copies stand in a row and five lie in the foreground; an open copy shows illustrated text pages with a facsimile document. Edition, year, printing and any limited-edition number are not visible (the title page was not photographed). Search snippets seen on 19/10/2026 (pages not opened) list the hardcover as published in 1985 by Historic Australia Publishing, Sydney, with used copies asking about AU$49.74 to AU$75 (https://biblio.com.au/9780958883603) and a signed copy numbered 248 of 1000 asking AU$190 (https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/254159092316). Those are asking prices, not sales.
condition: All copies look new or near new with clean covers and no visible wear; page condition cannot be judged.
rescore_note: Nine near new copies of Penzig's Ben Hall book, a respected title with a small but steady collector market and a misleading lot title; my estimate about $100 to $160 for the nine, more only if signed and numbered copies are among them (no live comps).
